subject: Post-call: SDK integration sprint plan, auth/routing, and local test setup
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed sprint plan: SDK quickstart, auth & routing, local testing

Emma — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have a tight on-ramp for your pilot: 

Key takeaways
- Goal: embed search + lightweight reranker in your product (TypeScript web front-end + Python embeddings pipeline).
- Security: you need control-plane separation (Private/VPC) for audit logs; initially OK with hosted sandbox for dev.
- Priority: auth + request routing (region pinning) and a sample end-to-end local test (sdk -> embeddings -> reranker).

Proposed sprint plan (rough, 2 weeks):
1) Day 0–2: SDK quickstart + env checklist (we attach a short checklist and a starter sample app).
2) Day 3–6: Auth setup (API keys vs. mTLS for your environment), role-based routing rules for dev/prod.
3) Day 7–10: Embeddings pipeline + local reranker test (Python sample + TS client).
4) Day 11–14: Validate latency & costs on a small dataset, capture basic SLOs; handoff to your SRE.

Immediate asks for you (can reply inline):
- Confirm whether you prefer TypeScript-first or Python-first sample apps.
- Which cloud region you want to pin for the pilot (us-west1 / us-east1 / eu-west1).
- Who on your eng team should get sandbox credentials this week?

Attachments: SDK_quickstart_checklist.pdf, sample-app-starter.zip (contains TypeScript + Python minimal clients).

I'll create a short repo and drive folder with code snippets and an example.env to populate. If that plan looks good I'll schedule a 30-min technical follow-up (neha + marcus + your eng lead).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Emma Park <emma@lumenai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed sprint plan: SDK quickstart, auth & routing, local testing

Thanks Neha — this looks great and aligned with our needs. Quick answers: 

- Prefer TypeScript-first for the front-end demo; we'll wire Python for embeddings in the backend pipeline.
- Region: us-west1 is best for our latency targets.
- Please send sandbox creds to eng@lumenai.com (I cc'd them here).

A couple of follow-ups:
- We want a small example of structured output / tool-calling for our agent flow — can the TS sample include an example of function-calling style output?
- For reranking, do you have a plug-and-play Py example that demonstrates embedding + FAISS + a simple logistic reranker we can run locally?

Attaching our internal requirements doc (lumen_requirements.docx). Happy to hop on the 30-min technical call — let's pick times after 9/13.

— Emma
Emma Park
Head of Product, LumenAI
emma@lumenai.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@lumenai.com>, LumenAI engineering <eng@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed sprint plan: SDK quickstart, auth & routing, local testing

Great — thanks for the quick replies. Short replies inline and resources below.

Function-calling / structured output
- Yes — the TS sample will include a basic example using the SDK's function-calling helper: a /generate tool that returns JSON with {action: string, payload: {...}}. We'll include a small validator in the repo.

Reranker + local playbook
- We have a Python example that uses embeddings -> FAISS (onnx-backed) -> small sklearn logistic reranker. I will drop a minimal notebook in the repo.

Sandbox creds and env
- I'll provision sandbox API keys scoped to the Lumen engagement and share to eng@lumenai.com by EOD.
- Attached: example.env (rename to .env locally). Do NOT paste the sandbox key into public repos.

Links / quick starters
- Repo (starter templates, TS + py): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-templates/tree/main/lumen-samples
- Onramp playbook (dev checklist): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-lumen-onramp-playbook
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/record/67890

Small snippet (TS function-calling example)

const response = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'redwood-chat-1',
  messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'Find top docs about contract terms'}],
  functions: [{name: 'searchDocs', parameters: {type: 'object'}}],
  stream: false
});

// validate response.output.function_call.payload before execution

Next steps I will take by EOD:
- Push starter repo branch with TS function-calling example + Python notebook for embedding+rerank.
- Provision sandbox API keys and email eng@lumenai.com.

If Marissa or Marcus want to weigh in on recommended Dedicated config for the pilot, cc'ing them here.

Thanks,
Neha

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@lumenai.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed sprint plan: SDK quickstart + auth/routing

Hi Emma / Neha — quick note from infra/product side: 

For the initial pilot (embeddings + light reranking) our recommended config is the "dedicated-small" profile:
- 1 x 40GB GPU node, pinned in us-west1 for predictable latency
- Autoscale buffer set to +1 for short bursts during ingestion
- Routing: we can add a rule that pins Lumen's traffic to us-west1 and falls back to hosted in other regions with lower priority (transparent to the SDK).

If you'd like, we can spin up a 14-day dedicated trial run under your account to validate token costs and tail latency. That requires a short internal approval (I can route with finance once you confirm).

I'll also attach a short checklist in the drive for compliance items we'll need if you move to Private (KMS setup, audit log retention).

If 9/15–9/16 works, Neha and I can join a 30-min technical session to walk through the repo and provisioning steps.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Product Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Emma Park <emma@lumenai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed sprint plan: SDK quickstart, auth/routing, local testing

Thanks Neha / Marcus — that all sounds good. Please go ahead with:
- TS-first sample branch in the repo
- Sandbox creds to eng@lumenai.com
- 14-day dedicated trial in us-west1 (we'll review costs)

9/15 at 3pm PT works for the 30-min tech session — I put the invite on everyone's calendar.

Appreciate the quick turnaround, looking forward to the starter repo.

— Emma
